q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-13. Q2 FY2027 earnings would typically be released around August 2026 (for the quarter ending July 2026). Given that we're already in mid-August 2026, this guidance has likely already been issued or will be issued within days. The resolution date is essentially immediate or has just passed.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provided explicitly states that **NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026 as $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**.

This is not a prediction question — it's asking about guidance that has already been provided. The answer is definitively **$91.0 billion** (with the stated ±2% margin of error, meaning the guidance range is $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion).

The research cites:
- investor.nvidia.com (official investor relations)
- sec.gov (SEC filing)
- nvidianews.nvidia.com (official NVIDIA news)

All three sources confirm this figure was announced on May 20, 2026 in the Q1 FY2027 earnings report.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

Nothing at this point — the guidance has already been released. If this is asking about the *actual* Q2 FY2027 revenue (not the forward guidance), then underperformance could occur due to:
- Weaker-than-expected data center demand
- Customer inventory corrections
- Geopolitical disruptions (export restrictions, especially to China)
- Competitive pressure

However, the question explicitly asks for "forward guidance," which refers to the company's stated expectation, not actual results.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

Again, if asking about the already-issued guidance: nothing — it's been announced. If asking about actual results exceeding guidance, factors would include:
- Stronger AI/data center demand than anticipated
- Higher ASPs (average selling prices)
- Accelerated customer orders
- Better-than-expected gross margins

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides a specific historical reference: NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 forward guidance of **$91.0 billion** was released May 20, 2026, with a ±2% margin (range: $89.18B to $92.82B).

This is the actual guidance that was issued, not a forecast of what it will be.

---

## Conclusion

The question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?" The research confirms this guidance has already been released: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026, as part of its Q1 FY2027 earnings report. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, with a margin of error of plus or minus 2%. This outlook explicitly does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This figure is notably higher than the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion from LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA also provided guidance for Q2 FY2027 gross margins, expecting GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP operating expenses are projected at approximately $8.5 billion, and non-GAAP operating expenses at $8.3 billion [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/).
